_source: Class leftovers (mage): the removed Kadim Kıyamet (mage_arcane_cataclysm) is no longer on any bar. Each node that referenced it points to an existing mage skill, same effect shape. PM-TAL format; applied by tools/apply-talent-patch.mjs, then tools/gen-talent-data.mjs regenerates src/data/talentTrees/raw/mage.ts.
_format: node = tree / slot+option; oldFx -> newFx; newName null = keep the old Turkish name; newDesc = Turkish description for the new fx.
